risks.title: Utility discovery clashes with TM phasing
risks.description: Live gas, water, telecoms or HV apparatus is discovered during excavation and clashes with the planned traffic-management phasing, forcing re-sequencing.
risks.mitigation: Early utility surveys, trial pits, CAT/GPR scans, and joint planning with undertakers before TM fixation.
risks.contingency: Localised TM redesign, diversion or hand-dig under permit; re-sequence possession.

risks.title: Unforeseen ground conditions / contaminated land
risks.description: Ground conditions differ from the design assumptions, including contamination, peat or soft ground.
risks.mitigation: Adequate GI coverage, geotechnical risk register, and a contingency in the earthworks method.
risks.contingency: Ground improvement, redesign of foundations, or disposal/treatment of contaminated arisings.

risks.title: Ground settlement affects adjacent structures
risks.description: Dewatering, excavation or piling causes settlement affecting adjacent buildings, structures or services.
risks.mitigation: Pre-construction condition surveys, monitoring, and settlement-control measures in the temporary works design.
risks.contingency: Suspend affected works, install additional support, repair/compensate affected parties.

risks.title: Ecology season constraints delay GCN works
risks.description: Great crested newt, bat and breeding-bird mitigation is season-constrained and the licence or works miss the window.
risks.mitigation: Early surveys, early Natural England licence applications, and a mitigation programme aligned to season windows.
risks.contingency: Reschedule affected clearance/demolition to the next window; phased working to avoid the closed season.

risks.title: CPO objections delay land access
risks.description: Objections to compulsory purchase delay vesting and possession of land required for construction.
risks.mitigation: Early engagement with landowners, negotiated acquisition first, and a robust CPO strategy.
risks.contingency: Phased possession, temporary rights, or scheme re-sequencing around unavailable plots.

risks.title: Night closure lane rental cost overrun
risks.description: Overrun on night closures under a lane-rental scheme incurs charges and erodes contingency.
risks.mitigation: Realistic closure planning, readiness checks, and conservative scope per closure.
risks.contingency: Reduce scope per closure, add contingency closures, or move works to daytime possessions.

risks.title: Surfacing weather windows missed
risks.description: The surface course cannot be laid within suitable weather windows, deferring completion.
risks.mitigation: Programme surfacing into the season, weather-watch, and contingency days.
risks.contingency: Re-sequence to the next window, temporary surfacing, or extend programme.

risks.title: Public Inquiry prolongation / DCO delay
risks.description: A Public Inquiry or examination extends the consenting timetable and delays the start of construction.
risks.mitigation: Strong pre-application engagement, a well-evidenced Environmental Statement, and proactive inquiry preparation.
risks.contingency: Re-baseline the programme, advance off-critical-path packages, or scope phasing.

risks.title: BIM/DMRB compliance gaps
risks.description: Designs or the information model fail to meet DMRB or BIM Level 2 requirements, causing rework or acceptance rejection.
risks.mitigation: Compliance checking at design gates, EIR clarity, and BIM management.
risks.contingency: Targeted rework and formal Departure from Standard submissions where required.

risks.title: Traffic diverge/merge safety near site works
risks.description: Diverge/merge layouts near live works create collision risk for road users and workers.
risks.mitigation: TM designed to standard, safety inspections, and Stage 1/2/3 RSA at gates.
risks.contingency: Re-design tapers, add signage/vehicle restraint, or restrict the closure.

risks.title: Steel price escalation on structures
risks.description: Structural steel price escalation increases structures cost above the estimate.
risks.mitigation: Early ordering of long-lead steel, fixed-price agreements, and value engineering.
risks.contingency: Re-scope, alternative materials, or draw on contingency.

risks.title: As-built survey data incomplete
risks.description: As-built survey information is incomplete at handover, delaying completion and O&M acceptance.
risks.mitigation: Survey-as-you-go, CDE enforcement, and milestone checks.
risks.contingency: Targeted re-survey campaign before handover.

risks.title: Long-lead gantry/VMS delivery delay
risks.description: Gantries and VMS arrive late, deferring technology installation and commissioning.
risks.mitigation: Early orders, factory acceptance tests, and supplier surveillance.
risks.contingency: Re-sequence installation, expedite, or phased technology enablement.

risks.title: MIDAS/HSR integration software defects
risks.description: Smart-motorway technology integration reveals software defects delaying commissioning.
risks.mitigation: Early interface definition, factory testing, and staged integration.
risks.contingency: Software patches, extended test period, or phased go-live.

risks.title: Asphalt plant capacity / bitumen supply
risks.description: Asphalt plant capacity or bitumen supply constrains the surfacing programme.
risks.mitigation: Secure plant allocation, alternate suppliers, and tonnage scheduling.
risks.contingency: Use alternate plants, adjust mix, or re-sequence surfacing.

risks.title: Piling refusal / obstructions
risks.description: Piling encounters refusal or obstructions not anticipated in the design.
risks.mitigation: Adequate GI, pile trial, and obstructions protocol.
risks.contingency: Re-design piles, pre-drill, or change pile type.

risks.title: Drainage outfall flooding / discharge consent
risks.description: Outfall capacity or discharge-consent conditions constrain drainage design and works.
risks.mitigation: Early engagement with the Lead Local Flood Authority and Environment Agency.
risks.contingency: Attenuation upgrade, alternative outfall, or phasing.

risks.title: HV cable strike during excavation
risks.description: Striking an HV cable during excavation causes serious injury or fatality and outage.
risks.mitigation: Permit to dig, CAT/GPR scanning, hand-dig zones, and cable-avoidance training.
risks.contingency: Stop work, emergency response, isolation and investigation.

risks.title: Night-time working fatigue / incident
risks.description: Fatigue from repeated night shifts increases the likelihood of incident.
risks.mitigation: Roster controls, fatigue management, and welfare provision.
risks.contingency: Reduce night exposure, rotate crews, or pause non-critical night works.

risks.title: VRS non-conformance / wrong system spec
risks.description: An installed VRS does not match the certified system or containment required.
risks.mitigation: Certified product procurement, installation inspection, and impact-certification checks.
risks.contingency: Remove and replace non-conforming system before opening.

risks.title: Late design change (scope creep)
risks.description: Late design changes in construction cause rework, delay and cost growth.
risks.mitigation: Robust change control, design freeze at gates, and early client decisions.
risks.contingency: Evaluate change through formal change control and re-baseline.

risks.title: Inflation / interest rate impact on funding
risks.description: Construction inflation and interest-rate movements erode the funding envelope.
risks.mitigation: Forecast monitoring, hedging where applicable, and value engineering.
risks.contingency: Scope/value engineering, re-profiling, or sponsor re-approval.

risks.title: Stakeholder objection / political delay
risks.description: Political or stakeholder opposition delays consents or approvals.
risks.mitigation: Proactive stakeholder engagement and clear communications.
risks.contingency: Enhanced engagement, concessions, or phasing.

risks.title: Archaeology finds causing delays
risks.description: Significant archaeological finds during works halt progress in an area.
risks.mitigation: Desk-based assessment, evaluation trenching, and agreed mitigation in advance.
risks.contingency: Localised stop, record and preserve, and re-sequencing.

risks.title: Weather disruption days exceeding allowance
risks.description: Weather disruption days exceed the programme allowance, delaying critical works.
risks.mitigation: Seasonal planning, weather-watch, and resilient methods.
risks.contingency: Re-sequence, extend hours, or use the time-risk allowance.

risks.title: Subcontractor insolvency / capacity
risks.description: A key subcontractor becomes insolvent or lacks capacity, threatening delivery.
risks.mitigation: Prequalification, financial checks, and dual-sourcing critical packages.
risks.contingency: Bring in alternative subcontractor, novation, or self-delivery.

risks.title: Pavement quality non-conformance / rework
risks.description: Pavement layers fail compaction or materials testing, requiring rework.
risks.mitigation: Method statements, plant calibration, and in-situ testing.
risks.contingency: Localised planing and relaying, and revised method.

risks.title: Concrete curing delays (cold weather)
risks.description: Cold-weather concreting causes curing delays and programme impact.
risks.mitigation: Cold-weather method, insulation, and accelerated mixes.
risks.contingency: Heated enclosures, extended curing, or re-sequence.

risks.title: Lighting electrical energisation delay
risks.description: Lighting energisation slips due to supply or electrical-completion issues.
risks.mitigation: Early cable/equipment procurement and commissioning tracking.
risks.contingency: Phased energisation and temporary supplies.

risks.title: Traffic modelling underestimate
risks.description: Traffic modelling underestimates demand, prompting late design change.
risks.mitigation: Robust model validation and independent assurance.
risks.contingency: Design review and capacity adjustment.

risks.title: Land compensation cost escalation
risks.description: Land compensation and disturbance costs exceed provision.
risks.mitigation: Early valuation, negotiated settlement, and expert support.
risks.contingency: Negotiate, refer to Lands Tribunal, or phase scheme.

risks.title: Section 278 agreement delay with local authority
risks.description: S278 agreement negotiation with a local authority slips, affecting programme.
risks.mitigation: Early engagement and pre-agreed technical basis.
risks.contingency: Escalation, parallel approval routes, or phasing.

risks.title: Noise / vibration complaints from residents
risks.description: Construction noise and vibration generate resident complaints and reputational risk.
risks.mitigation: Section 61 agreements, monitoring, working-hour controls and comms.
risks.contingency: Best practicable means review and working-method change.

risks.title: Embedment of environmental mitigation
risks.description: Environmental mitigation is not fully embedded in design and construction.
risks.mitigation: Mitigation tracked into the design register and inspected at construction.
risks.contingency: Targeted mitigation retrofit and monitoring.

risks.title: Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) shortfall
risks.description: The scheme does not deliver the required BNG units.
risks.mitigation: BNG metric tracking, land secured for compensation, and design integration.
risks.contingency: Off-site compensation or statutory biodiversity credits.

risks.title: Carbon budget exceedance
risks.description: Embodied and construction carbon exceed the scheme carbon budget.
risks.mitigation: Carbon assessment at design gates and low-carbon material options.
risks.contingency: Material substitution, re-design, or offsetting.

risks.title: Programme float erosion / critical path slippage
risks.description: Critical-path slippage erodes float and threatens key milestones.
risks.mitigation: Schedule risk analysis, recovery planning, and float protection.
risks.contingency: Recovery plan: parallel working, additional resources, scope re-sequencing.

risks.title: Inadequate TM leading to incident
risks.description: Inadequate TM installation or operation causes a road-user or worker incident.
risks.mitigation: TM design to standard, inspections, and competent crews.
risks.contingency: Cease works, rectify TM, and investigate.

risks.title: Temporary works failure
risks.description: Temporary works (falsework, excavation support) fail during construction.
risks.mitigation: Temporary works design and check, permits, and monitoring.
risks.contingency: Evacuate, make safe, redesign and re-install.

risks.title: Material testing failure (compaction/binder)
risks.description: Routine materials testing fails, indicating systemic quality issues.
risks.mitigation: Plant calibration, method control, and trend analysis.
risks.contingency: Stop, investigate, rework affected lots.

risks.title: Gantry foundation concrete strength failure
risks.description: Gantry foundation concrete fails to achieve design strength.
risks.mitigation: Mix design, batching control, and curing.
risks.contingency: Additional cubes, coring, or re-cast foundation.

risks.title: Sign/VMS structural certification delay
risks.description: Signs and VMS structural certification slips, deferring commissioning.
risks.mitigation: Early certification planning and supplier engagement.
risks.contingency: Phased certification and temporary arrangements.

risks.title: Regulatory / statutory approval timing
risks.description: Required regulatory approvals are not obtained to programme.
risks.mitigation: Consent schedule, early submissions, and tracking.
risks.contingency: Escalation, re-sequencing, or phasing.

risks.title: Asphalt / aggregate price escalation
risks.description: Asphalt and aggregate prices escalate beyond estimate.
risks.mitigation: Bulk procurement and indexed agreements.
risks.contingency: Value engineering and contingency draw-down.

risks.title: Labour shortage (skilled steel erectors)
risks.description: Shortage of skilled steel erectors and specialists delays structures works.
risks.mitigation: Early resource planning and framework agreements.
risks.contingency: Reschedule, bring in specialist teams, or extend duration.

risks.title: Bridge strike during construction (overheight vehicle)
risks.description: An overheight vehicle strikes a structure under construction or temporary works.
risks.mitigation: Height clearance, signing, and protection.
risks.contingency: Inspection, repair, and temporary protection.

risks.title: IT/network outage affecting smart motorway systems
risks.description: Network or IT outage affects smart-motorway systems during commissioning or operation.
risks.mitigation: Redundant comms paths, backups, and resilience testing.
risks.contingency: Failover, manual operation, or delay go-live.

risks.title: Public complaint volume / community relations
risks.description: High complaint volumes damage community relations and reputational standing.
risks.mitigation: Community liaison, complaints system, and proactive comms.
risks.contingency: Escalated engagement and remedial action.

risks.title: Cost reporting inaccuracy / change control
risks.description: Inaccurate cost reporting or weak change control hides cost growth.
risks.mitigation: Robust cost reporting, change register, and independent assurance.
risks.contingency: Cost reconciliation, re-baseline, and contingency review.

risks.title: Insurance / premium increases
risks.description: Insurance premium increases or coverage restrictions affect cost.
risks.mitigation: Early renewal, risk improvement, and broker engagement.
risks.contingency: Re-tender cover and absorb premium increase.

risks.title: Environmental incident (spillage / pollution)
risks.description: A spillage or pollution incident occurs, harming watercourses or land.
risks.mitigation: Pollution prevention, bunding, and emergency response plans.
risks.contingency: Containment, clean-up, and regulator notification.

risks.title: Incomplete O&M documentation
risks.description: O&M documentation is incomplete at handover, delaying maintainer acceptance.
risks.mitigation: Documentation tracked to milestones and CDE enforcement.
risks.contingency: Targeted documentation campaign before handover.

risks.title: Geotechnical design assumption invalid
risks.description: Geotechnical design assumptions are invalidated by actual ground conditions.
risks.mitigation: Adequate GI, conservative assumptions, and verification during construction.
risks.contingency: Re-design of earthworks/foundations and re-sequencing.

risks.title: Construction phase plan inadequacy (CDM)
risks.description: The CDM construction-phase plan is inadequate or not maintained.
risks.mitigation: Plan maintained live, audited, and reviewed.
risks.contingency: Plan re-issue and corrective actions.

risks.title: Access / possession window curtailment
risks.description: Possession or access windows are curtailed, reducing available working time.
risks.mitigation: Robust closure planning, handback discipline, and contingency closures.
risks.contingency: Re-allocate works to later closures, add closures, or re-sequence.

risks.title: Demolition / asbestos discovery
risks.description: Demolition reveals asbestos or hazardous materials, halting enabling works.
risks.mitigation: Pre-demolition surveys and licensed removal planning.
risks.contingency: Licensed removal, re-sequencing, and disposal.
